concepts.gloss_en: the counsel of the tzaddikim — the righteous ones' advice through which one receives their intellect-drops (טפי השכל) and comes to truth (emet), contrasted with עצת נחש/רשעים

reason_for_human: All 7 occurrences sit inside one lesson (Torah 7) and mean exactly the same thing — the counsel of tzaddikim that brings one to emet → emunah → redemption, opposed to עצת נחש/רשעים. The definite/indefinite alternation (הַצַּדִּיקִים in 7_3_1 vs צַדִּיקִים in 7_5_1/7_5_4) is grammatical noise within the same passage, not an archetype-vs-generic contrast, so I merged the two round-1 groups. Note: round-1 also misfiled occ:2432 ('לַעֲצַת צַדִּיקִים', indefinite) under the definite group — now moot since it's one concept.
